heroContent.title: Our Comprehensive Programs
heroContent.text: Explore the six core pillars of Kwetu Connect that drive cultural resilience, community wellbeing, and sustainable opportunities.

s1MentalHealthAndWellbeing.heading: Redefining Mental Health & Wellbeing
s1MentalHealthAndWellbeing.text: We provide culturally responsive mental health services that empower communities to tackle wellbeing challenges head‑on. Our approach blends community‑led counseling, digital mental health tools, and anti‑stigma campaigns to foster resilience and hope.

s2CulturalExchangePrograms.heading: Cultural Exchange & Partnerships
s2CulturalExchangePrograms.text: Our exchange programmes connect Indigenous knowledge holders with global partners, fostering mutual learning, artistic collaborations, and sustainable trade pathways.

s3CommunityChaplaincyRehabilitation.heading: Community Chaplaincy Rehabilitation Services
s3CommunityChaplaincyRehabilitation.text: We deliver holistic rehabilitation that blends spiritual care, mentorship, and practical life‑skill support, assisting individuals transitioning back into community life.

s4JobOpportunitiesAndCaregiver.heading: Navigating Job Opportunities & Caregiver Support
s4JobOpportunitiesAndCaregiver.text: Empowering both job seekers and caregivers through tailored career pathways, skills recognition, and wellbeing resources.
s4JobOpportunitiesAndCaregiver.item5: Wellbeing and mental‑health resources for caregivers

s5SeniorsWisdomAndGuidance.heading: Promoting Belonging Through Seniors' Wisdom
s5SeniorsWisdomAndGuidance.text: Harnessing the experience of senior community members to mentor youth, preserve cultural knowledge, and strengthen inter‑generational bonds.

s6TurningVulnerabilityIntoOpportunities.heading: Turning Vulnerability into Opportunities
s6TurningVulnerabilityIntoOpportunities.text: A strengths‑based framework that transforms community challenges into innovative solutions, fostering resilience and sustainable growth.
